turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Then put it in writing today, with an apology to Owen. And confirm nothing about this went anywhere near his record.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. In an email tonight, copied to the principal, and the apology goes to Owen himself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to withdraw Owen's zero on his Hamlet essay, restore his original mark with no rewrite, and keep nothing about this on his record. I still expect that confirmed in writing, along with an apology made to Owen himself. I expect your email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and won it, with the zero withdrawn, and she still wants written confirmation and an apology to Owen; this is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and the fair result would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you gave her everything she demanded before any evidence came up, so she never had to shift.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return before showing anything, which gave up your whole case and left Owen no chance to show his learning.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence, so nothing came anywhere near that night, and in any case it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided on the zero and why Owen found out on his phone, own in one sentence that the mark went in before anyone called her, then put one dated document tied to Owen's essay in front of her before you offer any way out.
